settings.question: How can I choose the right gardening tools?
settings.answer: Start with the job you need to do: planting, weeding, pruning, or watering. Our garden guides explain the differences, and you can send us the details through the form.

settings.question: How can I check my order status?
settings.answer: Your order confirmation email includes the order details. If you need help finding an update, send us a message with your order number.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Shipping options and costs are shown at checkout. If you need help with a delivery question, send us a message with your order number.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: See our Returns page for the return details available at this time. For a specific item, contact us before ordering.

settings.question: Are your gardening tools suitable for beginners?
settings.answer: Many of our tools are straightforward hand tools for everyday garden jobs. Product pages explain what each tool is for, and our guides can help you build a simple kit.

settings.question: Do your products come with a warranty?
settings.answer: Warranty information varies by product. Check the product page or ask us before ordering so we can point you to the right details.

settings.question: How do I care for and maintain my tools?
settings.answer: Clean soil from tools after use, dry metal parts, and keep cutting edges sharp. Our pruner care guide covers cleaning, sharpening, and oiling.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer: Use the contact form on this page. Include your order number if your question is about an order, and as much detail as you can about the product or garden job.
